document_contracts.description: Overall design contract requires a non-empty requirement design artifact.
Overall design contract requires a non-empty architecture design artifact.
Overall design contract requires at least one item design document artifact.
Overall design item design document artifact must be valid JSON array content.
Overall design item design document entries must contain path and content fields.
Overall design breakdown artifact must be valid JSON when present.
Overall design breakdown entries must contain documentPath fields.
Overall design breakdown document references must be covered by item design documents.
